text:
Maya: Quick idea — can we add a 'savings shadow' overlay to the burn-map so teams can see potential savings (cache + quantization estimates) vs actual token burn? People keep asking how much they'd save if they pinned a variant or enabled a quant profile.

Raj: Sounds useful. Do you mean per-route projections or per-tenant? Per-route looks expensive to compute.

Olivia: Ideally both with a toggle. Per-tenant default, per-route on-demand. Also want latency-adjusted cost (token cost * latency penalty) so SRE can weigh tradeoffs.

Simon: UX caution — overlays get noisy. Maybe an opacity slider + a dedicated "what-if" mode so it doesn't clutter the default view.

Maya: Data side: we have telemetry for cache hits, KV counts, and model-variant deltas. Main open question: attribution rules for shared KV cache hits — who gets the savings credit?

Raj: Proposal: credit to the last-write route owner within a 24h window; otherwise split by invocation weight across routes that accessed the cached prefix.

Olivia: Splitting by invocation weight is fair but painful historically. Can we approximate via sampled traces + heuristics for long-lived keys?

Simon: Console plan: small toggle in top-left "Savings shadow". When enabled, show shadow + a diff panel on click. Add a compact sparklines row for burn velocity + shadow overlay.

Maya: Example query for pull of candidates (proto):
```sql
SELECT tenant_id, route, sum(tokens) AS tokens, sum(cache_hit_tokens) AS cache_tokens, model_sku
FROM token_telemetry
WHERE ts > now() - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY tenant_id, route, model_sku;
```

Raj: Need model_sku breakdown and per-variant quantization delta table so we can estimate token-cost reduction for a suggested profile.

ConsoleBot: NOTE: feature-flag required — create FF: burn_shadow_enabled (owners: eng-console). :white_check_mark: 

Olivia: Rollout suggestion: internal dev preview -> beta for power customers -> GA. Also add canary sampling rate for heavy tenants so we don't blow up aggregation jobs.

Raj: Another important UX/data note — show raw burn AND projected burn side-by-side. If customers see only projected (lower) burn they might lower alerts / quotas and cause under-provisioning.

Maya: Agree. Header tooltip: "Raw tokens vs projected tokens after suggested savings (assumptions listed)".

Simon: Add a small "explain" panel listing assumptions: cache crediting window, sampling rate, quant delta per variant, confidence level. Can we show a confidence badge (low/med/high)?

Raj: Implementation notes: heavy compute if we do per-route historical splits. Suggest pre-aggregates (daily) + a realtime approximate layer (hourly sketch). We'll likely need a nightly job to materialize projection tables.

Olivia: Ops request: include a confidence score per projection based on sampling density and model churn. Also emit telemetry events for any route that toggles a suggested optimization so we can measure adoption.

Maya: I'll spin up a short RFC with architecture notes and a basic UX mock. TL;DR: overlay + toggle + what-if slider + per-tenant/per-route toggle + assumptions/explain panel + FF + canary + confidence score.

Simon: :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Started deployment of FF burn_shadow_enabled to staging (run 1234). ETA ~12m.

Maya: Thanks — I'll pair with Raj on the query shapes tomorrow morning. Ping me if anyone wants to join.
